objective: Improve ISAForge LUT4 prediction accuracy while reducing false hardware-budget acceptances and repairing remaining false rejections, without sacrificing previously validated gains; demonstrate the result on fresh circuits.
relationship_to_original_goal: Clarifies current work; does not replace or relax the frozen completion requirements in boundary-repair-goal.json or any experiment protocol.

current_evidence.interpretation: Prior structural correction improved selected cases, but the complete fresh general panel failed the false-rejection gate. No successful promotion is claimed.

next_bounded_experiment.purpose: Separate added training coverage from the effect of 16 localized structural features. Select using development evidence only, before fresh labels.

success_requirements: Repair the four remaining cap128 false rejections and preserve all 30 named required rejection corrections; never use labels, candidate IDs, or per-case lookup during inference.

Preserve prior accuracy, false-acceptance, subgroup and tail-error gains against the exact comparators and tolerances declared in the frozen protocol. Evaluate false acceptances and false rejections separately at caps32/64/128; do not offset one with the other.

Keep consumed evaluation labels out of training. Freeze cohorts, features, policies, selection rules and gates before new labels, and freeze fitted weights and all fresh predictions before fresh synthesis labels.

Require better MAE and MAPE than the signed incumbent on the complete fresh general panel, preserve budget-release gains, and meet every predeclared per-cap and subgroup gate. Report MAPE definition, zero-target handling and denominators.

Evaluate fresh general, conditional and newly changed active cases separately. Require at least four unique newly learned active corrections across at least two templates, including cap128; no post-label selection, replacement or quota refill.
Audit source provenance, chronology, training membership, saved-model inference, synthesis labels and RTL correctness independently. Retain every negative result and frozen artifact.

Publish reproducible evidence and concise research figures on latest. Complete the goal or promote a model only when every required gate passes; finite circuit results are not proof of universal hardware safety or CPU speedup.
failure_policy: Record the failure and analyze it. Any revised experiment needs a new preregistered protocol and fresh independent evaluation; never weaken acceptance gates after seeing results.
